sections.title: Pairs needing contact
sections.sql: select code,mentor,mentee,quiet_days,health from pair_health where status='active' and health<>'on cadence' order by code

sections.title: Goals due
sections.sql: select code,match,title,owner,due,state from goal_progress where status='open' order by due

sections.title: Active workload
sections.sql: select code,name,capacity,active_matches,available from mentor_capacity order by code

sections.title: Review findings
sections.sql: select * from compliance_checks order by code,rule
